title: 2662. Minimum Cost of a Path With Special Roads

examples.explanation: (1,1) to (1,2) with a cost of |1 - 1| + |2 - 1| = 1. (1,2) to (3,3). Use specialRoads[0] with the cost 2. (3,3) to (3,4) with a cost of |3 - 3| + |4 - 3| = 1. (3,4) to (4,5). Use specialRoads[1] with the cost 1. So the total cost is 1 + 2 + 1 + 1 = 5.
It is optimal not to use any special edges and go directly from the starting to the ending position with a cost |5 - 3| + |7 - 2| = 7. Note that the specialRoads[0] is directed from (5,7) to (3,2).
(1,1) to (1,2) with a cost of |1 - 1| + |2 - 1| = 1. (1,2) to (7,4). Use specialRoads[1] with the cost 4. (7,4) to (10,4) with a cost of |10 - 7| + |4 - 4| = 3.
